assumptions: The bounds and forbidden sites given are the design's real requirements.
limits: A composition: validated parts do not add up to a validated whole, so it is graded against an independent oracle rather than the engines it calls.
Says what broke and where; it does not repair it.
bio.jane/contract.question: Is this designed sequence admissible: protein unchanged, forbidden sites absent, frame intact, length, GC and CAI within bounds?

description: Decide whether a sequence is scientifically admissible: protein unchanged, forbidden restriction sites absent, reading frame intact, length/GC/CAI inside stated bounds. Every verdict names what broke, where, and the remedy. Run this after any design or optimisation step, and stop the chain when `admissible` is false — never report a designed sequence without it.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cai_organism.description: host for the codon-adaptation check, e.g. sce. Advanced.

forbid_sites.description: enzyme names that must not cut, e.g. BsaI, BsmBI.

gc_window.description: judge every window of this many bases instead of the whole sequence — a synthesis is rejected on a local GC peak, not on the mean. In bp. Advanced.

preserve_protein_of.description: the ORIGINAL coding sequence (or its protein): the result must still translate to it.

require_frame.description: length divisible by 3 and no premature stop.

require_start.description: with require_frame: the first codon must be a start codon. Only applies when require_frame is true. Advanced.

require_stop.description: with require_frame: the last codon must be a stop. Only applies when require_frame is true. Advanced.

sequence.description: the sequence to judge — defaults to the open record.

name: check_invariants

admissible.description: every invariant was decided and held

failed.description: how many invariants did not hold

summary.description: one line per failure: value, requirement, remedy
